Steps: Submit POST request to /api/batches with empty items list
Verify rejection due to business rule preventing empty batch creation
TestCases.Expected: Batch creation is rejected with an error indicating at least one valid item must be included per BRULE-37 and related BRULE-36 Empty Batch Prevention.

TestCases.TestName: UpdateBatchItems_RemoveTraceability_LinkIsBroken

Attempt to persist changes

TestCases.Expected: Update is rejected with error indicating violation of batch integrity because all items must be valid and traceable as required by BRULE-37.

TestCases.TestName: CreateBatchWithInvalidOrNonTraceableItem_FailsBatchCreation

Check response for failure or rejection indicating batch integrity violation
TestCases.Expected: Batch creation is rejected or fails with error indicating item(s) must be valid and traceable per BRULE-37. No batch is persisted with invalid or non-traceable items.

TestCases.TestName: CreateBatchWithValidItems_PreservesItemValidityAndTraceability

Verify traceability links from batch items to their source records exist and are correct
TestCases.Expected: Batch is created containing all specified items. Each batch item remains valid and traceable to its original source record as per BRULE-37.
